snippet.title: Shadow Spell Saga TRAILER 2
snippet.description:
Available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3424230/Shadow_Spell_Saga_The_Winds_of_Fate/

Shadow Spell Saga: The Winds of Fate is an original fantasy RPG for fans of classic grid-based strategy games.
Guide Prince Landon and his allies on an epic journey across the Grenheim Empire and beyond!
